name: CadSpace
tagline: A modular CAD workspace for desktop and the browser
summary: CadSpace is an independent C# CAD application built with Uno Platform, Skia and OpenGL/WebGL. It pairs a familiar dark ribbon workspace with double-precision drafting, layers, blocks, rational splines, triangle-mesh modeling and ASCII/binary DXF exchange, exposing 77 command workflows through six independently reusable libraries.

heroStats.label: faster indexed picking vs. linear scan on 100,000 lines

highlights.title: Ribbon CAD workspace
highlights.text: Application menu, Quick Access, command search, contextual ribbon tabs, document tabs and Model/Layout tabs wired to one session.

highlights.title: Precision drafting
highlights.text: Double-precision lines, polylines, arcs, ellipses, splines, text, dimensions and hatches with absolute, relative and polar input.

highlights.title: Command line
highlights.text: Type commands and aliases with completion, resizable history and dynamic input driving the same command engine.

highlights.title: Snaps and grips
highlights.text: Indexed object snaps, grid, ortho and polar guidance, plus blue grips that preview and commit one undoable edit.

highlights.title: Mesh modeling
highlights.text: Primitives, extrusion, revolve, loft, sweep and bounded closed-mesh UNION, SUBTRACT and INTERSECT.

highlights.title: GPU 3D viewport
highlights.text: Depth-tested OpenGL/WebGL rendering with visual styles, perspective or orthographic cameras and a synchronized ViewCube.

highlights.title: Layers and linetypes
highlights.text: Virtualized Layer Properties and Linetype managers with ByLayer/ByBlock styles and per-object or global scales.

highlights.title: DXF exchange and recovery
highlights.text: ASCII/binary DXF with original-record provenance, plus checksummed recovery checkpoints every five seconds.

items: Lines, 2D/3D polylines, rectangles, circles, arcs, ellipses and points
Control-point rational splines of degree up to 3
Plain text, aligned dimensions and supported hatches
Constant and tapered polyline widths with PLINEWID and PEDIT
Move, copy, rotate, scale, mirror, offset, array and explode
Line-based trim, extend, fillet, chamfer, join and break
Crossing-window STRETCH and transactional grip editing
QSELECT and SELECTSIMILAR selection tools
Atomic, validated edits with undo/redo
Absolute, relative (@x,y) and polar (@d<a) coordinate input
Endpoint, midpoint, center, quadrant, intersection, perpendicular and tangent snaps
Grid, ortho, polar guidance and dynamic input
DIST and AREA measurement commands
Layers with color, visibility, locking, lineweight and linetype
Nested blocks with BLOCK and INSERT
Simple dash/gap/dot linetypes with ByLayer/ByBlock and scales
Model/paper-space separation with undoable layout create, rename and delete
BOX, CYLINDER, SPHERE and CONE primitives
EXTRUDE, REVOLVE, capped LOFT and parallel-transport SWEEP
Bounded closed-mesh UNION, SUBTRACT and INTERSECT
ROTATE3D, MIRROR3D and ALIGN3D transforms
Wireframe, hidden-line, shaded and shaded-with-edges visual styles
Perspective and orthographic cameras with display-only clipping
ViewCube with face/edge/corner picking and drag-to-orbit
Navigation bar for pan, zoom, orbit and projection
Docked, floating and auto-hide palettes with Escape rollback
Searchable Tool Palettes for commands and drawing blocks
Optional classic File/Edit/View/Draw/Modify/Tools/Help menus
Staged Options dialog with three workspace presets
Native .cadspace projects preserving DXF provenance
ASCII and binary DXF open and interchange export with loss reports
Checksummed recovery checkpoints every five seconds for dirty drawings
Workspace preferences stored separately from drawings

packages.name: CadSpace.Geometry
packages.role: Double vectors/transforms, OCS, rays/planes, intersections, triangulation and spatial index

packages.name: CadSpace.Model
packages.role: Immutable geometry, styles and blocks, scene cache, spline/hatch and mesh algorithms

packages.name: CadSpace.Engine
packages.role: Sessions, commands, selection/grips/snapping, undoable editing and workspace preferences

packages.name: CadSpace.Dxf
packages.role: DXF transport, interpreters and writers, native projects and recovery journal

packages.name: CadSpace.Rendering
packages.role: Cameras, Skia drafting and OpenGL geometry, text, pattern and selection passes

packages.name: CadSpace.Controls
packages.role: Public Uno workspace components, managers, palette host, ribbon and navigation

codeSamples.title: Try it in the command line
Bind the reusable workspace
Build and run
codeSamples.code:
git clone https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/CadSpace.git
cd CadSpace
dotnet workload install wasm-tools

# Windows, macOS or Linux/X11
dotnet run --project src/CadSpace.App -f net10.0-desktop -p:CadSpaceDesktopOnly=true

# Browser development host
dotnet run --project src/CadSpace.App -f net10.0-browserwasm

# Publish for this repository's GitHub Pages path
dotnet publish src/CadSpace.App -c Release -f net10.0-browserwasm \
  -p:WasmShellWebAppBasePath=/CadSpace/

playground.intro: The live build opens an editable studio floor plan, with a 3D model example available from the CS application menu.

tour.title: Draw from the command line
tour.text: Type RECTANG, 0,0 and 240,140, then CIRCLE, 120,70 and 30, and finish with ZOOM — one command or value per line.

tour.title: Select and grip-edit
tour.text: Click or window-select objects (Shift removes, Ctrl toggles), then drag a blue grip and release to commit one undoable edit.

tour.title: Manage layers
tour.text: Run LAYER to open the Layer Properties Manager and change a layer's color, visibility or lock state.

tour.title: Extrude into 3D
tour.text: Select a closed XY profile, run EXTRUDE, then use 3DORBIT or the ViewCube to orbit and VSCURRENT to change the visual style.

tour.title: Try mesh Booleans
tour.text: Create two overlapping BOX or SPHERE meshes, select both and run UNION, SUBTRACT or INTERSECT.

tour.title: Customize the workspace
tour.text: Float or auto-hide palettes, open Tool Palettes with Ctrl+3, and use OPTIONS or MENUBAR 1 to adjust the chrome.

architecture.name: Geometry
architecture.text: Double-precision math, intersections, triangulation and spatial indexing with no UI dependency.

architecture.name: Model and exchange
architecture.text: Immutable drawings, styles, blocks and mesh algorithms, plus DXF and native project I/O that depends on Model, not the UI.

architecture.name: Engine and rendering
architecture.text: A command state machine with selection, snapping and undo, alongside Skia drafting and OpenGL 3D renderers.

architecture.name: Controls
architecture.text: Public Uno ribbon, palettes, managers, ViewCube and navigation components that expose events to the host app.

boundaries: Development preview, not full AutoCAD parity or CUI/API compatibility
Mesh modeling is triangle-based, not an analytic ACIS/B-rep solid kernel
No DWG or ACIS decoding; arbitrary DXF editing is not universally lossless
Paper-space viewports, plotting, dynamic blocks and constraints remain unimplemented
3D requires an accelerated OpenGL/GLES/WebGL context; uses framebuffer readback, not zero-copy
